gemini_description.purpose: Provide critical safety, installation, and maintenance instructions for AstralPool water filtration and recirculation pumps.
gemini_description.summary: This document outlines the vital safety guidelines, environmental limitations, and regulatory standards required for the safe installation, startup, and maintenance of swimming pool pumps.

components.name: AstralPool Filtration/Recirculation Pump
components.description: A unit designed specifically for primary water filtration and recirculation in swimming pools.

procedure: Download and read the full instruction manual in PDF format from www.astralpool.com before starting installation and operation.
Verify that the pool water is clean and does not exceed a maximum temperature of 35 degrees Celsius.
Assign all assembly, installation, and maintenance tasks exclusively to qualified and authorized personnel.
Ensure electrical installation strictly complies with standard IEC/HD 60364-7-702 and relevant national pool safety regulations.
Do not install the pump in Zone 0 or Zone 1 areas (refer to page 97 of the manual for zone diagrams).
Install a suitable containment basin with an adequate drain in areas where water overflow is expected.

technical_details.detail: Applicable safety and electrical installation standard: IEC/HD 60364-7-702.
Prohibited installation areas: Zone 0 and Zone 1.
Source URL for PDF documentation: www.astralpool.com

warnings.warning: It is strictly forbidden to install the pump inside Zone 0 or Zone 1.
This appliance is not intended for use by persons (including children) with reduced physical, sensory, or mental capabilities, or lack of experience, unless under supervision.
Children aged 8 and above must be supervised or instructed on safe use; they must not play with the device or perform cleaning and maintenance without supervision.
A suitable basin with drainage must be placed where water leakage or overflow is likely to occur.
